response.sql: SELECT language_id, AVG(replacement_cost) AS average_replacement_cost, AVG(length) AS average_running_time FROM film WHERE length IS NOT NULL AND length >= 112 GROUP BY language_id ORDER BY average_running_time IS NULL, average_running_time DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A qualifying running time is at least 112 minutes, including the cutoff. The request does not specify which side of the cutoff qualifies or whether 112 is included.
